    ,a.CURVE_NAME                       as curv_name              -- 曲线名称

    ,a.CURVE_TYPE_CODE                  as curv_type_cd           -- 曲线类型代码

    ,a.QUOTE_TYPE                       as quot_type              -- 报价类型

                                        as rec_down_time          -- 记录创建时间

left join (select * from t02_pub_covt_const where src_id = 'WD' and const_type_cd = 'fin00001') b
    on a.CURVE_CURRENCY = b.src_const_cd

with tmp_ref_instrument as (
select *,
    case when a.CURRENCY = 'CNY' then '156'

         when a.CURRENCY = 'HKD' then '344'
         when a.CURRENCY = 'EUR' then '978'
         when a.CURRENCY = 'JPY' then '392'
     else a.CURRENCY  end                                                                as crrc_cd
    ,case when a.CURRENCY = 'CNY' then '人民币元'
          when a.CURRENCY = 'USD' then '美元'
          when a.CURRENCY = 'HKD' then '香港元'
          when a.CURRENCY = 'EUR' then '欧元'
          when a.CURRENCY = 'JPY' then '日元'
     else ''  end                                                                        as crrc_name

          when a.INS_FAMILY = 'FUTURE'                   then 'FUT'          
          when a.INS_FAMILY = 'INDEX'                    then 'IDX'        
          when a.INS_FAMILY = 'FUND'                     then 'FIN'        
          when a.INS_FAMILY = 'LISTEDOPTION'             then 'OPT'

          when a.INS_FAMILY = 'OTC_OPTION_CONTRACT'      then 'OPT'                       
          when a.INS_FAMILY = 'FX'                       then 'FXR'

     else 'OTH'     end                                                                 as   scr_type

    ,trim(a.WIND_CODE)                                                                  as scr_cd  
    ,a.INS_LNG_DESC                                                                     as ch_name
    ,a.DESCRIPTION                                                                      as ch_abbr_l
    ,case when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'ICE_EU'    then 'LSE'   
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'NAS'       then 'NASDAQ'
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'OTC'       then '99'    
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'PBC'       then '99'    
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'NYS'       then 'NYSE'  
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'ASE'       then 'AMEX'
          when a.EXCH_MARKET is null       then '99'
     else a.EXCH_MARKET    end                                                          as mkt_cd
    ,case when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'SGE'              then '上海黄金交易所'                                              
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'HKEX'             then '香港联交所'

          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'CFETS'            then '中国外汇交易所'                                                           
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'CBOT'             then '芝加哥期货交易所'                                                               
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'LME'              then '伦敦金属交易所'                                                        
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'CZCE'             then '郑州商品交易所'                                                          
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'DCE'              then '大连商品交易所'                                                         
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'SHFE'             then '上海期货交易所'                                                          
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'CFFEX'            then '中国金融期货交易所'                                                           
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'SSE'              then '上海证券交易所'                                                         
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'SZSE'             then '深圳证券交易所'                                                          
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'INE'              then '上海期货交易所-上海国际能源交易中心'                                                                
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'OSE'              then '大坂证券交易所'                                                         
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'COMEX'            then '纽约商品交易所'                                                           
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'SGX'              then '新加坡交易所'                                                         
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'EUREX'            then '欧洲期货交易所'                                                           
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'ICE_EU'           then '伦敦洲际交易所'       
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'NAS'              then '纳斯达克证券交易所'   
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'OTC'              then '其他'                 
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'PBC'              then '其他'                 
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'NYS'              then '纽约证券交易所'       
          when a.EXCH_MARKET = 'ASE'              then '美国证券交易所'

insert overwrite table t02_tit_scr_base_info  partition (src_id = 'TIT',grp_id = '01')
select 
    '${data_day_str}'                                                                                          as busi_date                      --数据日期                                                                        
    ,''                                                                                                             as rec_id                         --记录编号                                                 
    ,nvl(b.secu_id,concat(a.scr_type,'.',a.ID ,'.',coalesce(split(a.scr_cd,'\\\\\\\\.')[0],a.in_code),'.',a.mkt_cd))                                                                                                      as secu_id                        --统一证券编码                                                          
    ,nvl(b.src_sys_prdno,concat('TIT-',a.in_code))                                                                                                as src_sys_prdno                  --源系统产品编号                                                                      
    ,nvl(b.crrc_cd,a.crrc_cd)                                                                                                      as crrc_cd                        --货币代码                                                          
    ,nvl(b.crrc_name,a.crrc_name)                                                                                                    as crrc_name                      --货币名称                                                              
    ,''                                                                                                             as cty_cd                         --国家代码                                                  
    ,''                                                                                                             as cty_name                       --国家名称                                                    
    ,''                                                                                                             as corp_id                        --公司id                                                   
    ,''                                                                                                             as scr_stat                       --当前状态                                                    
    ,''                                                                                                             as min_pric_chg_unit              --最小价格变动单位                                                             
    ,a.peru                                   as peru    --每手数量    --2024-09-18 wxliyaqian 修改，之前是预留字段默认给的空值                                                                                                             
    ,nvl(b.scr_type,a.scr_type)                                                                                                     as scr_type                       --证券类别                                                            
    ,a.INS_FAMILY                                                                                                   as scr_type_src                   --源证券类别(EQUITY-股票,FUTURE-期货,INDEX-股指,FUND-基金,LISTEDOPTION-场内期权,OTCOPTION-场外期权,TRS-收益互换,RATE_INDEX-浮动利率,HEDGE_FUND-私募基金,OTC_OPTION_CONTRACT-场外期权合约,FX-货币对,QIS-策略指数,COMMODITY-商品,GDR-存托凭证,BOND-债券)                                                                    
    ,nvl(b.ch_abbr,a.ch_abbr)                                                                                                      as ch_abbr                        --证券简称                                                          
    ,nvl(b.scr_cd,split(a.scr_cd,'\\\\\\\\.')[0])                                                                                                       as scr_cd                         --证券代码                                                        
    ,a.WIND_CODE                                                                                                    as wind_cd_src                    --源万得代码                                                                
    ,''                                                                                                             as ch_abbr_pinyin                 --中文拼音简称                                                          
    ,nvl(b.ch_name,a.ch_name)                                                                                                      as ch_name                        --证券中文名称                                                          
    ,''                                                                                                             as en_name                        --证券英文名称                                                   
    ,nvl(b.ch_abbr_l,a.ch_abbr_l)                                                                                                    as ch_abbr_l                      --证券简称(长)                                                              
    ,''                                                                                                             as en_abbr                        --英文简称                                                   
    ,nvl(b.mkt_cd,a.mkt_cd)                                                                                                       as mkt_cd                         --交易市场代码                                                        
    ,nvl(b.mkt_ch_name,a.mkt_ch_name)                                                                                                as mkt_ch_name                    --交易市场中文名称                                                                  
    ,case when a.IS_UNDERLYING_VISIBLE = 'Y' then 1
          when a.IS_UNDERLYING_VISIBLE = 'N' then 0 
          end                                                                                                       as underlying_visible_flag        --可见穿透持仓标志(0否1是)                                                                                      
    , default.date2datekey(a.MATURITY_DATE)                                                                         as due_date                       --到期日                                                                 
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(a.CREATED_DATETIME),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')                                        as create_time_src                --源创建日期                                                                           
    ,a.ISSUER_ID                                                                                                    as issuer_id                      --发行人                                                              
    ,a.DATA_SOURCE                                                                                                  as date_src                       --数据来源                                                               
    ,''                                                                                                             as src_cd                         --来源编码                                                  
    ,''                                                                                                             as upper_src_cd                   --来源编码（大写）                                                        
    ,a.KEY_INSTRUMENT_ID                                                                                            as in_code                        --源内部编码                                                                    
    ,a.SUMMARY_MAPPING                                                                                              as undrl_clas                       --标的汇总分类   --2023-11-08新增字段 by wxliumengyuan
    ,''                                                                                                             as remark                         --备注                                                  
    ,'odata_n_tit.d_ref_instrument'                                                                                 as src_tbl                        --来源表                                                                               
    ,''                                                                                                             as src_rec_id                     --来源记录                                                      
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(a.UPDATED_DATETIME),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')                                        as rec_upd_time                   --数据更新时间                                                                      
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')                                                          as rec_down_time                  --数据进表时间
    ,a.EXCH_MARKET                                                                                                  as src_mkt_cd                     --源交易市场代码  --2023-11-08新增字段 by wxzhengziyang
    ,a.base_underlying_ins_id                                                                                       as scr_incd_gdr                   --基础证券内码(GDR)
    ,a.transform_proportion                                                                                         as tran_prop_gdr                  --转换比例(GDR)
    ,a.ins_subtype                                                                                                  as sub_type                       --产品子类
    ,a.industry_name                                                                                                as indt_name                      --行业信息
    ,a.industry_code                                                                                                as indt_cd                        --行业代码
from (select *, 
cast(row_number() over(partition by scr_type, mkt_cd, in_code order by in_code) as bigint) + 100000000 as ID 
from 
tmp_ref_instrument) a
left join 
(select * from t02_scr_base_info where src_id = 'TIT') b on b.in_code = a.KEY_INSTRUMENT_ID 
;

select cal_date,exchange_code,is_holiday,wk_n,year_n,mon_n,qtr_n

,case when is_holiday='N' then

,case when is_holiday='N' then

end mon_tn
,case when is_holiday='N' then

end qtr_tn
,case when is_holiday='N' then

end wk_tn1
,case when is_holiday='N' then
row_number() over(partition by exchange_code,year_n order by case when is_holiday='N' then cal_date end desc)  --这里不能有else
end year_tn1
,case when is_holiday='N' then
row_number() over(partition by exchange_code,year_n,mon_n order by case when is_holiday='N' then cal_date end desc) --这里不能有else

,case when is_holiday='N' then
row_number() over(partition by exchange_code,year_n,qtr_n order by case when is_holiday='N' then cal_date end desc) --这里不能有else
end qtr_tn1
,case when is_holiday='N' then
row_number() over(partition by exchange_code order by case when is_holiday='N' then cal_date else '9999-12-31' end )
end tn
from (
select substring(cal_date,1,10) as cal_date,exchange_code,is_holiday
,floor(datediff(substring(cal_date,1,10) ,'2018-01-01')/7) as wk_n--所在周数 从2018-01-01(周一)开始算第一周

when substring(cal_date,6,2) in('04','05','06') then '2'
when substring(cal_date,6,2) in('07','08','09') then '3'

       ,a.strike_price                                                                                  AS exer_pric --行权价格

       ,a.adj_sign                                                                                      AS adj_flag --调整标志

       ,a.created_by                                                                                    AS creator --创建人

       ,a.exercise_type                                                                                 AS exer_way  --行权方式            --新增字段 by wxliupengfei 20241029
       ,''                                                                                              AS remark --备注 
       ,'odata_n_tit.r_ref_listed_option_props'                                                         AS src_tbl --来源表 
       ,''                                                                                              AS src_rec_id --来源记录 
       ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(a.updated_datetime),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')                         AS rec_upd_time --记录修改时间 
       ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')                                           AS rec_down_time --记录创建时间

(

	FROM odata_n_tit.r_ref_listed_option_props

(
	select * from t02_scr_base_info where src_id = 'TIT'
) b
on a.key_instrument_id = b.in_code

        ,c.corp_id                                                                as corp_id                --统一企业编号

        ,f.const_cd                                                             as co_behav_type          --公司行为类型                                                                                                                  
        ,default.date2datekey(a.record_date)                                    as reg_date               --登记日(股票:股权登记日,基金:权益登记日)                                                                                                              
        ,default.date2datekey(a.ex_date)                                        as ex_dvd_date            --除息日(股票:除权除息日,基金:除息日)

        ,default.date2datekey(a.pre_plan_ann_date)                              as plan_disc_ntce_date    --预案预披露公告日(仅股票)

        ,bonus_ratio                                                            as stk_divd_prop          --送股比例(仅股票)

left join (select * from t02_scr_base_info where src_id='TIT')  b 
on a.key_instrument_id = b.in_code 
left join (select * from t02_scr_base_info where src_id='WD')  c 
on b.secu_id = c.secu_id 
left join (select * from t02_pub_covt_const where src_id='TIT'  and const_type_cd='var00609')  d 
on a.ca_type = d.src_const_cd 
left join (select * from t02_pub_covt_const where src_id='TIT'  and const_type_cd='var00610')  f 
on a.ca_subtype = f.src_const_cd 
left join (select * from t02_pub_covt_const where src_id='TIT'  and const_type_cd='fin00001')  g 
on a.currency_code = g.src_const_cd 
left join (select * from t02_pub_covt_const where src_id='WD'  and const_type_cd='evt00001')  h

insert overwrite table t02_tit_scr_base_info  partition (src_id = 'TIT',grp_id = '01')
select 
    '${data_day_str}'                                                                                          as busi_date                      --数据日期                                                                        
    ,''                                                                                                             as rec_id                         --记录编号                                                 
    ,nvl(b.secu_id,concat(a.scr_type,'.',a.ID ,'.',coalesce(split(a.scr_cd,'\\\\\\\\.')[0],a.in_code),'.',a.mkt_cd))                                                                                                      as secu_id                        --统一证券编码                                                          
    ,nvl(b.src_sys_prdno,concat('TIT-',a.in_code))                                                                                                as src_sys_prdno                  --源系统产品编号                                                                      
    ,nvl(b.crrc_cd,a.crrc_cd)                                                                                                      as crrc_cd                        --货币代码                                                          
    ,nvl(b.crrc_name,a.crrc_name)                                                                                                    as crrc_name                      --货币名称                                                              
    ,''                                                                                                             as cty_cd                         --国家代码                                                  
    ,''                                                                                                             as cty_name                       --国家名称                                                    
    ,''                                                                                                             as corp_id                        --公司id                                                   
    ,''                                                                                                             as scr_stat                       --当前状态                                                    
    ,''                                                                                                             as min_pric_chg_unit              --最小价格变动单位                                                             
    ,a.peru                                   as peru    --每手数量    --2024-09-18 wxliyaqian 修改，之前是预留字段默认给的空值                                                                                                             
    ,nvl(b.scr_type,a.scr_type)                                                                                                     as scr_type                       --证券类别                                                            
    ,a.INS_FAMILY                                                                                                   as scr_type_src                   --源证券类别(EQUITY-股票,FUTURE-期货,INDEX-股指,FUND-基金,LISTEDOPTION-场内期权,OTCOPTION-场外期权,TRS-收益互换,RATE_INDEX-浮动利率,HEDGE_FUND-私募基金,OTC_OPTION_CONTRACT-场外期权合约,FX-货币对,QIS-策略指数,COMMODITY-商品,GDR-存托凭证,BOND-债券)                                                                    
    ,nvl(b.ch_abbr,a.ch_abbr)                                                                                                      as ch_abbr                        --证券简称                                                          
    ,nvl(b.scr_cd,split(a.scr_cd,'\\\\\\\\.')[0])                                                                                                       as scr_cd                         --证券代码                                                        
    ,a.WIND_CODE                                                                                                    as wind_cd_src                    --源万得代码                                                                
    ,''                                                                                                             as ch_abbr_pinyin                 --中文拼音简称                                                          
    ,nvl(b.ch_name,a.ch_name)                                                                                                      as ch_name                        --证券中文名称                                                          
    ,''                                                                                                             as en_name                        --证券英文名称                                                   
    ,nvl(b.ch_abbr_l,a.ch_abbr_l)                                                                                                    as ch_abbr_l                      --证券简称(长)                                                              
    ,''                                                                                                             as en_abbr                        --英文简称                                                   
    ,nvl(b.mkt_cd,a.mkt_cd)                                                                                                       as mkt_cd                         --交易市场代码                                                        
    ,nvl(b.mkt_ch_name,a.mkt_ch_name)                                                                                                as mkt_ch_name                    --交易市场中文名称                                                                  
    ,case when a.IS_UNDERLYING_VISIBLE = 'Y' then 1
          when a.IS_UNDERLYING_VISIBLE = 'N' then 0 
          end                                                                                                       as underlying_visible_flag        --可见穿透持仓标志(0否1是)                                                                                      
    , default.date2datekey(a.MATURITY_DATE)                                                                         as due_date                       --到期日                                                                 
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(a.CREATED_DATETIME),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')                                        as create_time_src                --源创建日期                                                                           
    ,a.ISSUER_ID                                                                                                    as issuer_id                      --发行人                                                              
    ,a.DATA_SOURCE                                                                                                  as date_src                       --数据来源                                                               
    ,''                                                                                                             as src_cd                         --来源编码                                                  
    ,''                                                                                                             as upper_src_cd                   --来源编码（大写）                                                        
    ,a.KEY_INSTRUMENT_ID                                                                                            as in_code                        --源内部编码                                                                    
    ,a.SUMMARY_MAPPING                                                                                              as undrl_clas                       --标的汇总分类   --2023-11-08新增字段 by wxliumengyuan
    ,''                                                                                                             as remark                         --备注                                                  
    ,'odata_n_tit.d_ref_instrument'                                                                                 as src_tbl                        --来源表                                                                               
    ,''                                                                                                             as src_rec_id                     --来源记录                                                      
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(a.UPDATED_DATETIME),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')                                        as rec_upd_time                   --数据更新时间                                                                      
    ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')                                                          as rec_down_time                  --数据进表时间
    ,a.EXCH_MARKET                                                                                                  as src_mkt_cd                     --源交易市场代码  --2023-11-08新增字段 by wxzhengziyang
    ,a.base_underlying_ins_id                                                                                       as scr_incd_gdr                   --基础证券内码(GDR)
    ,a.transform_proportion                                                                                         as tran_prop_gdr                  --转换比例(GDR)
    ,a.ins_subtype                                                                                                  as sub_type                       --产品子类
    ,a.industry_name                                                                                                as indt_name                      --行业信息
    ,a.industry_code                                                                                                as indt_cd                        --行业代码
from (select *, 
cast(row_number() over(partition by scr_type, mkt_cd, in_code order by in_code) as bigint) + 100000000 as ID 
from 
tmp_ref_instrument) a
left join 
(select * from t02_scr_base_info where src_id = 'TIT') b on b.in_code = a.KEY_INSTRUMENT_ID 
;

       ,E.CONST_CD                                                              AS undrl_crrc_cd --标的币种

LEFT JOIN

	FROM T02_SCR_BASE_INFO

LEFT JOIN
(

ON A.key_underlying_ins_id = C.IN_CODE 
LEFT JOIN
(

	FROM T02_PUB_COVT_CONST
	WHERE SRC_ID = 'TIT' 
) D
ON A.strategy_currency = D.SRC_CONST_CD
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  *
	FROM T02_PUB_COVT_CONST
	WHERE SRC_ID = 'TIT' 
) E
ON A.stock_currency = E.SRC_CONST_CD


;

            when a.IS_KNOCKED_IN = 'N' then 0
            ELSE a.IS_KNOCKED_IN END                                as knocked_in_flag                  -- 敲入标志（0否1是）

        ,a.CORRELATION_VALUE                                        as correl_val                       -- 相关性数值
        ,a.FX_VOLATILITY                                            as vola                             -- 波动率
        ,a.CEGA                                                     as cega                             -- CEGA
        ,a.RHO_R                                                    as rho_r                            -- RHO_R
        ,a.RHO_Q                                                    as rho_q                            -- RHO_Q
        ,a.RHO_RF                                                   as rho_rf                           -- RHO_RF
        ,a.VEGA_FX                                                  as vega_fx                          -- VEGA_FX
        ,a.DELTA_FX                                                 as delta_fx                         -- DELTA_FX
        ,a.rho_q_base                                               as rho_q_base                       -- rho_q(本币)  --20231212 wxzhengziyang 新增字段
        ,a.cega_base                                                as cega_base                        -- cega(本币)   --20231212 wxzhengziyang 新增字段
        ,a.department                                               as dept_no                          -- 所属部门
        ,''                                                         as remark                           -- 备注
        ,'odata_n_tit.d_v_greeks_pricing_rm'                        as src_tbl                          -- 来源表
        ,''                                                         as src_rec_id                       -- 来源记录
        ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')      as rec_upd_time                     -- 记录修改时间
        ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')      as rec_down_time                    -- 记录创建时间
        ,'TIT'                                                      as src_id                           -- 来源标识
        ,'01'                                                       as grp_id                           -- 并行标识
        ,substr(a.src_busi_date,1,10)                                                as busi_date                        -- 数据日期
    FROM (
        select * from odata_n_tit.d_v_greeks_pricing_rm_p 
        where busi_date ='h15'
    ) a 


    
;
